note: Minimum goals apply only to selected and qualified seeds within their scene quotas; unqualified seeds remain visible as coverage debt. Never silently redistribute all difficult themes away.
compatibility_notes: Axes are optional prompts, not a Cartesian product and not a geometric grammar.

Observe actual accepted diversity, not only requested tags.
